# The corpus's conditional laws in the grammar, each with a net where its condition fails

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`conditional-laws-of-the-corpus` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](conditional-laws-of-the-corpus.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Of the corpus's 219 conditional units, 128 fall into 22 families of laws, each written as Y iff Z or Z then Y with a net where Z fails and Y with it: 103 state laws that hold, 6 laws false as read, 19 premises. Of the rest, 33 turn on a valuation, 53 are not expressible, 5 are definitions.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Where everything goes on under a coarse class and every step of 缘 is parted by a fine class, every occurrence is generating (全生成): the coarse line never ends and a carrying renewal lies ahead of every point it reaches; day and night are an instance. Sufficient, the converse not claimed: a line that ends, and a step that keeps the class, do not generate. (`Becoming.«皆有后而步皆分则全生成»`, `Becoming.«昼夜全生成»`, `Becoming.«有亡而不全生成之例»`, `Becoming.«步不分而不全生成之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
2. Bounded room on the line itself: a line none of whose places comes back to itself is shorter than any list holding its places, so where a list holds the line from an occurrence, that line is not endless, though no end is exhibited. A line that comes back, or one no list holds, may never end; a merge, or no bound, keeps a line from coming back to its start. (`Becoming.«线不返则短于所列»`, `Becoming.«不返而有限则非不穷»`, `Becoming.counting_reach_lt`, `Becoming.«返而不穷之例»`, `Becoming.«无环而不穷之例»`, `Becoming.«有限遍后而不返之例»`, `Becoming.«遍后定前而无环之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. 前際 and 後際 mirror each other under the converse. What a class's core puts with an occurrence whose line never ends has a line that never ends, so an endless line and one that ends lie apart under the core, as ending is kept along the core and beginning along the core of the converse net. The forward core does not keep a beginning, the converse core relates pairs the core does not, and a line without beginning can end. (`Becoming.«类内有常则线相随»`, `Becoming.«核同则同不穷»`, `Becoming.«不穷与亡不同核之例»`, `Becoming.«生于核下可变之例»`, `Becoming.«逆核不含于核之例»`, `Becoming.«无始而有终之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
4. Dependence along 缘 (依: every occurrence with Q has a condition with P) is one-way. Where nothing is P, nothing is Q, and dependences compose along «而», so a chain of them is one law. Where Q has no P-condition, Q stands though nothing is P. (`Becoming.«依»`, `Becoming.«所依无则依者无»`, `Becoming.«依之传»`, `Becoming.«不依之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
5. Passing through: where a class is constant under 缘 and its converse, whatever has a predecessor passes through, altered or not, as the grammar's reading of 通 has it. The condition is sufficient, not necessary: under a class that is not constant an occurrence can end, alter and pass through. With no predecessor it does not pass through, though the class be constant both ways. (`Becoming.«不有常而通之例»`, `Becoming.«两向有常而无前不通之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. Three definitional laws state families exactly: what ends under a class alters, continued under another, exactly where it has a successor there, and with none ceases without altering; nothing alters under E and F (continued under E, told apart by F) exactly where F holds of the ends of every continuation under E; nothing begins under the one exactly where nothing lacks a condition, both up to double negation. (`Becoming.«亡者异当且仅当有后»`, `Becoming.«亡而息之例»`, `Becoming.«无异当且仅当不分续»`, `Becoming.«静分续而有异之例»`, `Becoming.«皆不生当且仅当皆非无缘»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Each family whose law the grammar's modules already state has a net where Z fails and Y fails with it: a lone occurrence, with no condition and no result, begins and ends under the one; counting at one ends under identity and abides under the one; a net without cycles has nothing co-present; the empty net has nothing conditioning. A joint class on three bits joining two distinct points witnesses 相须. (`Becoming.«生亡并之例»`, `Becoming.«亡于静而住于一之例»`, `Becoming.«无环则无俱有»`, `Becoming.«无能无所之例»`, `Becoming.«非有常之类不含于核之例»`, `Becoming.«有前不有常而亡之例»`, `Becoming.«无相而非亦无相之例»`, `Becoming.«像不保之例»`, `Becoming.«相须之例»`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Each reading of a unit as a law is an AI reconstruction, and each count counts readings: groups.tsv keeps every unit's family, disposition, labelled reading and the classifier's confidence. The classical text decides nothing; Lean checks only the derivation.
- The grammar's modelling choices: one carrier for every kind (perceivers and percepts fall under one class); 缘 a necessary relation between places of the net, with no predicate of presence; classes as relations; discrete steps.
- G03 and G04 add a bound the texts do not state: a list holding the line's places, bounded room.
- G08 (what occurs has conditions) and G20 (同類同情 as constancy) are premises of the model, not theorems. G13 assumes the occurrence is not its own condition; G21's converse assumes that being told apart at no stage is constant and the class symmetric.
- Each net where Z fails is one constructed model on a small carrier (Unit, Bool, Option, Nat), or a model the package already has.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That the texts state these laws or their authors meant them: a reading stands or is revised by its place in one account, and no person has reviewed these readings.
- An order 穷 → 变 → 通 in the grammar: the text states one with 則, but with 變 read as one alteration the three are a conjunction, constancy and not alteration giving passing through; whether the text's 變 is one alteration or an alternation (under which passing through follows by definition) the commentators divide on.
- Production or sufficiency: 生 as producing an occurrence not yet there is not expressible, since 缘 is a necessary relation between places of the net.
- That constancy is necessary for never ending or for passing through: both laws give sufficient conditions, with nets where the condition fails and the conclusion holds.
- That what depends on the beginningless is beginningless (JS-324 read through 故): what depends on a line without beginning can begin.
- The 91 units outside the families: the 33 that turn on a valuation and the 53 not expressible are kept with their reasons in groups.tsv, not forced in.
- **Counterexample:** CWS-P6+P7+P8-020, G11, read as the converse of 相须: a class that is not constant, under which a line never ends. («不有常而不穷之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ZL-21-113, G13: counting at one ends under identity and abides under the one, so not abiding under identity is not 斷. («亡于静而住于一之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ZL-17-051, G13: on the witness a result with no condition at all, not only no deed, abides under no class, so not 常, while another occurrence, the deed, has a successor, so not 斷. («无缘不住而他有后之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ZL-01-099, G16: what has no condition can end, and it abides under no class, so it is not 常. («生亡并之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)
- **Counterexample:** ZL-02-070, G16: own position read as own condition gives no beginning under any class; the unit is the premise of a reductio. («自缘而不生之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)
- **Counterexample:** QXL-JS-324, G15, read through dependence: what depends on a line without beginning can begin, given a class that tells the two kinds apart. («依于无始而有始之例») [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/GrammarConditionals.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · A conditional law does not make its antecedent universal; a theorem's premise is not thereby necessary for every achievement. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

Pure core, every axiom report empty: GrammarConditionals imports GrammarCandidates and GrammarLaws, a leaf nothing imports. The two general laws two families rest on are stated in the records of the laws they generalize, continuation relative to a class and the classical definitions. Written by an AI from the corpus's classification; one independent AI review, every finding taken; no human audit of the readings. The leaf, 40 theorems in 41 declarations, compiles with the whole package in the core run whose receipt the record binds.

<a id="history--沿革"></a>
### History

- 1 November 2026, board item OU7 (study section 492): added. The 219 units classed 丙一 read as laws of every carrier, relation and class, 128 of them in 22 families, each law with a net where its condition fails; the new laws and the witnesses in one core leaf, Becoming.GrammarConditionals; the two general laws two families rest on, in Grammar and GrammarReadings, stated in the records of the laws they generalize (continuation-relative-to-a-class, law 5; classical-definitions-in-the-grammar, law 4); one independent AI review of the design, every finding taken.
- 3 November 2026, the dossiers' re-sync: a correction. The first of the false-as-read witnesses for ZL-17-051 said more than the Lean states: its result has no condition at all, and a result with another condition can abide. The chapter's sentence and groups.tsv's row with it; the chapter's opening and home section now say, as this statement does, that 128 of the 219 are written as laws; its open list says what JS-318 denies, which is not JS-326's own premise. The statement and every count stand.
- 5 November 2026, board item RAE3 (AA Phase 0's E26): the open readings read in the corpus. G22: 「衡不正」 is, by Xunzi's own sentence, a reversal of the pair weighed, so 「重縣於仰」 is the text's stated consequence, not derived from non-preservation; whether every pair reverses the text does not say. G15: the 起信论's accord sense of 相應 (contrary, in the 勝鬘, 離, 脫, 異) is read as one class of the forward core, by fit, the text not choosing between the core and sameness of substance; whether 無明 is among its 煩惱染法 the text does not settle, and the carry-over to JS-324 fails either way. G01: the 繫辭 defines 變 three times and states the order with 則; whether its 變 is one alteration or an alternation the commentators divide on. Each [AI reading, new] in 06; no law, standing or count changed.
